item.tib: dkyil 'khor bri ba dang bca' ba
item.coloph: ces don yod zhags pa'i las mtha' 'chi bslu bar chod kun sel gyi bca' thabs lag len gsal byed nyi ma'i snying po zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mchog sprul rig 'dzin rnam gnyis kyi dngos slob thos chung dbang bdag la don gnyer can re 'gas bskul ba la brten nas rje gar dbang 'ja' tshon pa'i gsung sgros ci 'dra ba bzhin du bcos slad med par yongs (yang) me byi zla 3 tshes 25 la bkod pa dge legs su gyur cig//
